title: Local stack: Postgres 17 + MinIO + Mailpit via one command
author: codex

notes.blocked: Native Podman and host psql verification are unavailable on this machine. `PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" agents/scripts/flo up` exits 1 with `error: podman is required for the local stack but was not found on PATH`; `psql "$DATABASE_URL" -c 'select 1'` exits 127 with `zsh: command not found: psql`. The same compose file and flo control flow were verified end to end with Docker Compose via a temporary compatibility shim, and Postgres was queried successfully with the image's psql client.
notes.recap: Delivered a digest-pinned local Postgres 17, MinIO and Mailpit stack with dev/test database initialization and an idempotent attachment bucket. flo up, flo up --reset and flo down now health-gate startup, reset volumes and stop the stack.
